items.title: Eminem co-publisher Eight Mile Style adds 108 allegedly infringing AI tracks to $47.7m Suno lawsuit, calling Suno’s denials ‘false’
items.summary: The amended filing now accuses Suno of stealing Eminem's voice and likeness, but it adds no claim over them, and the damages it seeks are unchanged. Source

items.title: Judge throws out Wixen’s claims over 200-plus pre-1978 songs in copyright lawsuit against Meta, lets rest of case proceed
items.summary: The ruling strips more than a third of the 569 songs from the case, though Wixen's remaining infringement claims and its defamation claim survive. Source

items.title: Eminem’s Publishers Add 108 Examples to Copyright Lawsuit Against AI Platform Suno
DistroKid Hands Over AI Music Data in Suno Copyright Lawsuit
Music may be excluded from Australia’s AI-friendly copyright reforms - though ARIA says “we stand with the rest of the creative and media industries”
items.summary: This week the creative and media industries came together to oppose AI-friendly copyright reforms being considered by the Australian government. It’s now being reported that those reforms might not actually impact on music, though the music industry says it remains committed to the wider campaign

items.title: Australian creative sector bristles at ‘permit’ AI training plans
items.summary: It may seem like we’ve been writing a lot about AI-policy arguments in Australia recently, but there’s a bigger picture. The country’s music industry has been very clear about its belief that if AI companies persuade Australia’s government to weaken copyright protections in regard to training AI models, the ripples wil…

items.title: 5 things to know about Suno’s move into AI video, the DistroKid documents, and the fight over v6
items.summary: Suno moved into video this week, while DistroKid handed over AI-detection documents and UMG and Sony fought to keep their second lawsuit moving. Source

items.title: Opinion published on Belgium’s new artist-remuneration right
items.summary: Not just any rando’s opinion either: this is an opinion by the advocate general at the Court of Justice of the European Union, Maciej Szpunar, so it carries weight. And the opinion is on a long-running battle over the way Belgium has implemented the European Copyright Directive. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Las canciones creadas íntegramente con IA carecen de derechos de autor
Developing Music Lawsuit 2026: Suno, Udio, Sony Updates
Vast majority of consumers want AI music labelled, Deezer survey reveals, as SoundCloud and Spotify update AI policies and tools
items.summary: Deezer has surveyed 9000 consumers in nine markets about their attitudes towards AI music, with 80% of respondents saying AI tracks should be clearly labelled. The new stats coincide with updates from SoundCloud on its AI policies and Spotify on the roll out of its Artist Profile Protection feature

items.title: WMG and Spotify talk AI remixes and the need for artist consent
items.summary: This week’s Morgan Stanley European Technology, Media and Telecom Conference has been instructive – and not just for getting UMG’s view on AI-music ‘kill switches’. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Content ID no es lo mismo que ser dueño
tip.body: Que YouTube reclame un video a tu favor no prueba titularidad, y que no lo reclame no significa que puedas usar la obra. Content ID es un sistema privado de la plataforma, no una autoridad legal.

tip.title: Content ID is not proof of ownership
tip.body: A YouTube claim in your favor doesn't prove you own the work, and the absence of a claim doesn't mean you're cleared. Content ID is a private platform system, not a legal authority.
